chat.emptyBody: Ask for a picture ("draw a fox in the snow, 16:9"), workshop a prompt ("write me an Illustrious prompt for…"), ask how a model is prompted ("how does LTX prompting work?"), or talk through what you are working on.
chat.placeholder: Ask anything — Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line. Paste a picture to ask about it.
chat.searchDdgNote: Search sends your message to DuckDuckGo, which reads its plain results page. Nothing needs installing; the query leaves this PC.
chat.searchSearxNote: Search goes to your SearXNG, which proxies it. SearXNG must be running and allow JSON results.
chat.searchOffNote: Off: Chat never goes online. The Search button stays hidden.
chat.includeHelp: Sends Studio's current prompt, model and settings and your Prompt Forge draft with each message.
chat.render.desktopOnly: Pictures can only be made in the DEAS desktop app.
chat.render.noBackend: The backend is not running. Start it under Backend, then ask again.
chat.render.noCheckpoint: No checkpoint is selected in Studio → Generate. Select one there, then ask again.
chat.render.notTextToImage: Studio → Generate is not set to text-to-image. Switch its pipeline to text-to-image, then ask again.
chat.render.missing: Generate cannot run with its current settings (missing: {names}). Fix that in Studio → Generate, then ask again.
chat.render.history: Generate has a restored history entry that does not match its settings. Clear it in Studio → Generate, then ask again.
chat.render.badSize: That size could not be used ({aspect} {resolution}). Ask for a ratio like 16:9 or a size like 1920x1080.
chat.render.notStarted: Generate could not start this picture. See Studio → Generate or Logs for why.
chat.render.lost: Generate no longer has this job. Look for the picture in Media.
chat.render.noFile: The picture finished, but its file could not be found. Look for it in Media.
chat.render.timeout: Still not finished after 30 minutes. Look in Studio → Generate for its state.
chat.render.failed: Generate reported a failure. See Logs for the details.
